Azur Promilia is scheduled to officially launch on November 26 at 11:00 (UTC+9).

We are currently making final preparations for your adventure.

Please wait just a little longer until your journey across the continent of Promilia begins!

Starborn yang terhormat,

<mj mj="bg:1;font:ast_fontstyle_c24;font-color:white001">Astral Cord Observation: "Peach Blossom Pact"</mj>


[Event Period]

Nov 26, 2026 (after launch) - Dec 17, 2026 04:59 (UTC+9)

[Observation Details]

• During the event, the limited 5★ character "Tushan Xiaoyu (Assault / Wind & Light)" is available in "Peach Blossom Pact".

• During the event, the drop rates for 4★ characters "Maple (Amplification / Light & Wood)" and "Anis (Support / Light & Earth)" are significantly boosted.
